convention: East-positive longitude from -180 to 180 and planetocentric latitude, in degrees.

1.name: Walk-ready
1.offers: Everything: walking routes, tether, storm mode, photos, validation.

2.name: Scout-ready
2.offers: Walking routes and tether inside the terrain strip, marked 'not checked on the ground'.

3.name: Survey
3.offers: Layers and vehicle-scale route sketches only. No walking plan.

4.name: Overview
4.offers: Layered context map, radiation estimate by altitude, season and Sun. No routes.

sites.name: Bright Angel

position.what: A single point taken from the source.
position.source: Perseverance waypoints file, stop RMC 56_0, first logged on sol 1210
position.why: NASA says the Cheyava Falls rock core was collected on 21 July 2024 at the northern edge of Neretva Vallis. By our count from the landing date that is sol 1215, and the rover's log has it at this stop from sol 1210 until it next moved on sol 1219.
